description: A creative content generation SaaS web app and e-reader for AI-generated manga. It features dark mode, measured glassmorphism, neon purple/blue accents, and manga-inspired aesthetics.

typography.instructions: Use Bebas Neue for all major headings, chapter titles, and hero text to evoke a graphic novel/manga cover feel. Use Outfit for body text and UI elements for clean legibility.

colors.instructions: Strictly dark theme. NO teal green or Space Grotesk. NO generic purple gradients. Use solid neon accents against ink-black backgrounds. Gradients are only permitted for glowing borders or text effects, not large background fills.

visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: Measured glass effect: `backdrop-blur-2xl bg-slate-950/40 border border-white/10`. Use for sticky headers, bottom nav, and floating dialogs.
visual_enhancers.textures: Incorporate subtle CSS radial-gradients or SVG halftone/screentone dot patterns in the background to simulate printed manga paper in dark mode.

layouts.general: Responsive mobile-first. Max-width constraints on readable content (e.g., max-w-4xl for reader).
layouts.navigation: Desktop: Left Sidebar or Top Nav with glassmorphism. Mobile: Fixed Bottom Navigation Bar (`bottom-0 w-full backdrop-blur-2xl bg-slate-950/80 border-t border-white/10`).
layouts.home_hero: Massive Bebas Neue typography. High-contrast asymmetrical layout with diagonal visual cuts and floating manga panels.
layouts.my_library: Responsive Bento/Grid layout (`grid-cols-2 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4 lg:gap-8 gap-4`). Covers have aspect ratio 2:3 (standard manga format).
layouts.manga_detail: Bento split-pane. Left side: Manga Cover, Info, and Story Bible. Right side: Scrollable Chapter list and Characters. Distinct 'Generate Chapter' triggers with SSE progress.
layouts.manga_reader: Defaults to vertical scroll. `min-h-[100dvh]` flex-column shell. The manga panels are central, with absolute-positioned editable SVG overlays for dialogue bubbles.

components.Card: Use Shadcn Card as base but heavily customize: `rounded-xl bg-slate-900/50 backdrop-blur-md border border-white/10 shadow-lg`. Add `hover:-translate-y-1 hover:border-violet-500/50 transition-all` for interactive cards.
components.ButtonPrimary: `bg-violet-600 hover:bg-violet-500 text-white font-bold rounded-lg px-6 py-3 transition-colors shadow-[0_0_15px_rgba(139,92,246,0.3)] hover:shadow-[0_0_25px_rgba(139,92,246,0.6)]`
components.DialogBubble: Absolute positioned SVG elements over the manga images. Must have `contentEditable` or an input overlay for users to edit the text directly on the manga page. Style with `fill-white text-black border-2 border-black rounded-3xl`.
components.ProgressIndicator: Use glowing neon linear progress bars for SSE generation queues. Add `framer-motion` pulsing effects.

patterns.page_transition: Fade in and slide up slightly (`initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 10 }} animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }}`).
patterns.list_stagger: Stagger children in My Library and Chapter Lists for a cascading entrance.
patterns.hover_lift: Lift cards slightly (`-translate-y-1` or `scale-105`) with a border color transition to neon purple on hover.

hero_background.description: Dark neon cyberpunk alleyway for landing page hero background or Explore section header.

character_concept_1.description: Cloaked figure concept art. Use in Character Profiles or Story Bible reference.

character_concept_2.description: Sketch of character with a bird. Use as a sample AI generated character reference.

comic_panel_layout.description: Wireframe comic layout. Use as a placeholder for generating chapters or empty states in the Manga Reader.

cyberpunk_diner.description: Moody Tokyo diner with neon signs. Great for sample Manga cover image in My Library.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure text over neon elements meets WCAG AA standards. Use pure white text over primary buttons.
accessibility.testing: All interactive elements (buttons, inputs, reader controls, chapter triggers) MUST include a descriptive `data-testid` attribute (e.g., `data-testid="generate-chapter-btn"`).

instructions_to_main_agent: Implement the UI exclusively using React and Tailwind CSS.
Use standard JavaScript (.js/.jsx) instead of TypeScript.
Incorporate lucide-react for iconography. Use Framer Motion for all micro-interactions.
DO NOT use raw HTML inputs; heavily customize Shadcn UI components for all forms.

For the Manga Reader: Images must be wrapped in a container where SVG dialogue bubbles can be overlaid and edited. Use absolute positioning and handle responsive scaling of the bubbles relative to the image.
Theming: Enforce dark mode at the HTML/body root. The background should be `#05050A`. Do not use a generic centered App layout.
Mobile nav: Ensure a sticky bottom navigation bar is present on mobile breakpoints for quick access to Home, Library, Explore, Settings.
Client Auth: Generate and store a UUID in localStorage upon first visit for anonymous auth.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. Avoid the 'AI slop' aesthetic.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur).
You MUST NOT apply universal transition (e.g., transition: all). Add transitions for specific interactive elements excluding transforms.
You MUST NOT center align the app container, i.e., do not add `.App { text-align: center; }` in the css file.
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp buttons with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 etc for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects, and entrance animations.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Main agent relies on these image URLs. Missing categories = main agent will use placeholder text which is FORBIDDEN.
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui when applicable.
Use sonner for toasts, located in /app/src/components/ui/sonner.jsx (or .tsx equivalent if pre-installed).
